scope: Offline v1.10 development captures only. Test the existing same-frame direct slit pixel separately from the global material chart. Do not change the simulator, scene, control code, previous reports, or signed gates.
readout: Keep the v1.10 directly provable front, depth-backed silhouette/colour adjacency votes, 2-7 mm bank windows and minimum four votes per bank per supported row. Verify both ends, local adjacent cell, row order and original 1.5 mm physical bank-spread requirement independently. For a second readout, use the observed RGB-D transitions in image space: intersect each bank's local fitted row lines with the lateral transect through the actual reported front UV. In the original sheet-plane coordinate grid this is equivalently extrapolating each row's s(lateral) to the front's lateral position; this is an experimental apparent material readout, not evidence for physical bank agreement. Fit each bank independently by least squares, never pool the two banks to manufacture a missing row. Require both to identify the same consecutive labelled cell and agree within one existing 0.5 mm bin. Do not extrapolate longitudinally outside a supported material cell. A pre-cut front is zero only with same-frame entry evidence. Retain the independent physical and sweep checks; this probe cannot authorize any closure.
physical_check: Repeat the previous boundary-depth probe on these same frames to check endpoint identity/physical skew and conservative earlier-bank knots. Keep both rejections and unguarded diagnostic readouts. A more accurate apparent front alone cannot make a rejected chart safe.
reference: Scoring only: reconstruct the rendered triangles (same live spring edges and row labels as tissue.lua) at the frozen node positions. At pixels in the 1-pixel neighbourhood of the reported front UV, require a visible sheet label and raw depth agreement within 2 mm of the frontmost mesh hit. Compute perspective-correct material row at those pixels, with no continuation across empty slit, occluder or missing face. This is a check of where the current apex localizes, not the material coordinate of an empty ray, structural length evidence or a control input.
decision: For both withdrawn 10 mm reference ticks 16/17 require a guarded [9,10] mm readout; for nominal tick 26 and 0.5 mm noise tick 34 require guarded [4,6] mm. No guarded stop on any earlier sub-9 mm frame. Missing checkpoints or guards fail. Only consider live work if all checks pass; otherwise keep results diagnostic and do not tune the thresholds or select a more favourable apex on these samples.
